---
title: "Make a frequency table"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source('../assets/setup.R')
library(tidyverse)
```

A frequency table counts up the number of times each level of a categorical variable appears in the data.

We'll make a frequency table using the `msleep` dataset that comes from `tidyverse`.
`msleep` contains some data about how much different kinds of mammals sleep.
Here's what the first few rows of `msleep` look like.

```{r}
msleep |> head()
```

To make a frequency table for the variable `vore`, we take our data frame and [pipe](pipe.html){target="_blank"} it into the `tidyverse` function `count()`.
Inside the parentheses of `count()`, we name the column that we want to make the frequency table for.

```{r}
msleep |>
  count(vore)
```
